title: A family tree of software job titles
llm_summary: The post visualizes the sprawling hierarchy of software‑industry roles, tracing how titles have branched from classic “engineer” and “programmer” roots into modern variations like “dev‑ops engineer,” “site reliability engineer,” “machine‑learning researcher,” and the increasingly nebulous “senior” or “lead” designations. Commenters largely agree that the tree reflects both genuine specialization and a cultural drift toward title inflation—
